channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 19 sources (16 RSS feeds + 3 Hugging Face org pages). Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
item.description: Google has added Tool Retrieval to the Gemini API in preview, letting agents keep a large tool library on standby and load parameter schemas only when needed, cutting input tokens while keeping tool selection accurate.

item.title: Gemini 4 Neon in GitHub Copilot
item.description: GitHub Copilot now offers Google's latest Gemini 4 Neon for agentic coding, multistep tool calls and knowledge tasks.

In Claude Code 2.1.328, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 gain an automatic mode across Bedrock, Google Cloud, Foundry, and the apps gateway, and interactive sessions that skip permission prompts now begin there.

item.title: LangSmith Tool Gateway: Secure, governed tool use for agents
item.description: Now in public beta, LangSmith's Tool Gateway centralizes credential, identity, and access handling for agent tool calls, adding policy controls, approval flows, and trace visibility.
Claude Code 2.1.327 now confirms before /install-github-app touches a repository, and claude mcp add-json can take server JSON from stdin so tokens stay off the command line.

item.title: v0.24.0
item.description: The Agents SDK ships version 0.24.0, unifying run-wide function error formatting and adding MCP discovery annotations, while improving recovery, sandbox safety, and tracing.

item.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
item.description: The newest member of the Gemini 4 family, built for fast end-to-end completion of complex coding, knowledge work, and science tasks — positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen to balance frontier capability with cost efficiency, now available in the Gemini API and AI Studio.

item.title: Release v0.28.0-nightly.20261118.d9ac287c9f
item.description: Qwen Code ships a new nightly build improving scheduled-loop tests for managed agents and hardening PR verification guards and container logic.

item.title: v2.71.0 (2026-11-18)
item.description: Pydantic AI 2.71.0 is out, with changes to how multi-agent peer networks connect and how their interfaces are named, plus support for a new model provider, Stav.

item.title: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
item.description: Biographer Walter Isaacson joins Google to reflect on lessons from history's great innovators for staying creative and exercising judgment as AI advances.

item.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
item.description: OpenAI explains its internal performance system: Codex-powered workflows that continuously surface and fix performance issues so ChatGPT stays responsive as it scales.

item.title: v0.25.0
item.description: Agents SDK 0.25.0 opens up utilities for third-party session adapters, drops the Runloop sandbox provider, and adds opt-in handoff error recovery.

item.title: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
item.description: A compact open speech model with just 0.5B parameters, covering 40+ languages for speech tasks on resource-constrained devices.

item.title: Genie 4 is now available
item.description: DeepMind's interactive world model Genie 4 is now open, turning text or image prompts into explorable worlds you can move through in real time.

item.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
item.description: RadixArk's 27B-parameter DaisyRose explores getting stronger model performance from less post-training effort.

item.title: Announcing Data Annotation Queues
item.description: Use LangSmith’s Data Annotation Queues to review logs, label data, and build datasets that take LLM apps from prototype to production.

item.title: Checking for NGINX2Root and Java4Shell with Threats in Devin Security
item.description: Devin Security's Threats feature now checks customer code for the newly disclosed NGINX2Root and Java4Shell flaws and helps patch them.

item.title: v2.70.0 (2026-11-17)
item.description: Pydantic AI 2.70.0 fixes a high-severity security issue where stripping ANSI escapes in tool output limits could take quadratic time.

item.title: LangSmith for Coding Agents: Now track spend by outcome
item.description: LangSmith adds reporting for coding agents that ties their spending to the pull requests they ship, letting teams weigh the investment by actual results.

item.title: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
item.description: A 180B-parameter MoE model can now run on just 32GB of RAM, as Transformers streams experts on demand to make large-model inference friendlier to ordinary hardware.
